a.lede: Microsoft's Surface Laptop Ultra is now available for pre-order. The company revealed some new Windows 11 features, a new magnetic USB Type-C port, and that the system will work with "hundreds" of video games.
a.title: Microsoft and Nvidia launch Surface Laptop Ultra with RTX Spark

b.lede: Yes, it's just a premium laptop. But it sure looks pretty.
b.title: Surface Laptop Ultra hands-on: A beautiful beast powered by NVIDIA's RTX Spark
